{{Otheruses|Lightning}}
'''Generate lightning''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to produce bolts of energy from their fingers which could be used for a multitude of purposes. While it was fully capable of inflicting wounds on a target, it could also be used to fell trees or remove cave-ins.

Ascendants who wished to cast the generate lightning spell were required to know the [[detect life]], [[psychokinesis]] and [[sense life]] spells. The [[Shield (Ta-Ree spell)|shield]] spell could be used to deflect the lightning, or it could be dissipated by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] power [[Tutaminis]].
